name: D. John Sauer
current_role: Solicitor General of the United States (since April 2025)
summary: D. John Sauer, a former Missouri solicitor general, argued Trump’s presidential-immunity case at the Supreme Court in 2024, winning a 6–3 ruling, and has been U.S. solicitor general, the government’s top Supreme Court lawyer, since April 2025 after a 52–45 confirmation.
